svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Channel: one 3 mm blank 370 mm long, folded to a 98 mm wide base with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 mm walls (inside 92 mm: 1 mm clearance each side of the pack).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave the walls 40 mm taller for the last 45 mm at the upper end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the ears that carry the lever pin).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End stop: 12 mm plate 92 x 70 mm welded across the lower end, 15 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in; the pack's receptacle mounts on it on its floating mount.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lever: 30 x 8 mm bar 127 mm long on an 8 mm pin through the ears,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a pad block 40 x 10 x 58 mm that presses the pack's handle end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set the over-centre point so it closes with 50 N or less at the end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and gives 330 N or more on the pack, with a detent.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6.5 mm holes in the base, 240 mm apart, to the down tube tabs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: base on the tabs, M6 bolts; the pack slides down onto the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: receptacle and the lever closes over its top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: SwapCell interface v0.3 envelope gauge slides in freely.
